48.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must first meet the following requirements:

49.original: 1. FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail must be registered to your service account.<hex:02100103>2. You must be a beastmaster.

50.original: 3. You must have completed the First Master's Board.<hex:02100103>4. You must have befriended at least thirty beasts.

51.original: Your performance within the Crucible has been astounding. We're all in quite the ruffle!

52.original: Lady Lauda not least of all. She has been most restless, most secretive of late... Why, it was only thanks to the keenest of my senses that I discovered she added yet another board!

53.original: A board upon which, I understand, Lady Lauda herself shall challenge you─together with Ser Guttler!

54.original: Can you believe it!? A return match like no other!

55.original: Your bout will no doubt feel personal, but you mustn't let your guard down. Those two may be nigh unstoppable with their powers combined.

56.original: However, I have every faith that <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> will emerge the victor. Sally forth, <hex:02080EE905FF054C616479FF0453657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─to triumph!

57.original: The Second Master's Board has been unlocked. To challenge it, speak with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.
